div.div: Q. 1 عَطْرِدْهُ لَنَا Make thou it to be to us, (O, K,) with thee, or in thy estimation, (O,) like the promise, (كَالعِدَةِ, K, TA, inf. n. of وَعَدَ, and this is the only explanation given by the leading authorities on strange words, TA, [in the O, كَالعِدَّةِ,]) or like the apparatus that is prepared for the casualties of fortune; (كَالعُدَّةِ and العَتَادِ; Ibn-'Abbád, O, K;) and ↓ اِجْعَلْهُ لَنَا عُطْرُودًا signifies the same. (O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
